query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Crew/cabin service is a central review theme and a strong categorical axis to cross with Type of Traveller, Class and Overall Rating, so it gives real analytical leverage. Groundedness is mixed: rows 1,3,4,5 read the source correctly (welcoming/kind/well-trained/caring -> warm_proactive), but row 2 mentions only seats and entertainment and never discusses crew, yet was labelled 'rude_inattentive'. The near-absence of NULLs (157) plus this row suggests the column sometimes infers crew sentiment from overall review negativity rather than actual crew mentions.

per_column.name: service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Responsiveness is a plausible distinct sub-axis but heavily overlaps with crew_service_quality (a review with warm crew is scored responsive in every positive sample), so it adds only modest incremental leverage. Groundedness: positive rows are well supported, but row 2 (no service content at all) is coded 'absent', and with only 49 NULLs the operator appears to conflate 'not mentioned' with a substantive 'absent' value, asserting more than the text supports.

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: Food is a clean, independent theme highly useful for the query. It correctly abstains often (3428 NULL) and reads explicit food comments well (rows 1,3,4 -> excellent). However two silent samples were invented: row 2 (no food mention) -> 'poor' and row 5 (no food mention) -> 'adequate', tracking overall tone instead of returning NULL. These are clear groundedness failures on silent rows.

per_column.name: ground_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Ground/airport service is a genuinely separate theme with good analytical value. Rows 2 and 4 correctly return Unknown, but rows 1, 3 and 5 describe purely onboard experiences with no ground-service content yet are labelled 'positive' — a confident specific where the text is silent, evidently borrowed from overall positivity. Frequent invented positives undercut groundedness.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: Disruption handling is a distinct, high-signal theme for separating high vs low ratings. All five samples correctly return 'not_applicable' since none mention delays/cancellations, which is the correct abstaining behaviour and well grounded.

per_column.name: customer_service_resolution
per_column.rationale: Post-experience resolution is a meaningful, non-redundant axis. All samples correctly return 'not_contacted' with no evidence of customer-service interaction, showing appropriate abstention and sound grounding.

per_column.name: class_value_gap
per_column.rationale: A boolean touching on Class-vs-value is topically relevant, but its meaning is opaque and in the samples it simply tracks overall positive/negative sentiment (positive reviews -> True, the negative seat review -> False), making it largely a restatement of Value For Money / overall tone and thus limited new leverage. Values are broadly consistent with review polarity, so no outright contradiction, but the ambiguous definition weakens verifiability.

judge.rationale: The added set supplies several genuine, independently useful thematic axes (crew service, food, ground service, disruption handling, customer-service resolution) that are exactly the kind of review themes needed to cross-tabulate against Type of Traveller, Class and Overall Rating; only service_responsiveness is largely redundant with crew_service_quality and class_value_gap is a vague sentiment restatement, so overall usefulness is solid. Groundedness is the weaker dimension: disruption_handling and customer_service_resolution abstain correctly, but crew_service_quality, service_responsiveness, food_quality and ground_service_quality show a recurring pattern of assigning sentiment-aligned values to themes the review never mentions (e.g., the seat-only review labelled rude crew and poor food; onboard-only reviews labelled positive ground service). This systematic filling of silent themes with inferred polarity, rather than NULL, is a real fidelity concern that pulls the table-level groundedness down.
